name: Phillips Exeter Cube Day 2016

venue.name: Phelps Science Center, Phillips Exeter Academy
venue.details: The competition will be held in Grainger Auditorium (Ground floor of Phelps Science Center at Phillips Exeter Academy)

information: The registration fee is a flat $20 for any events over the two days of competition. PEA students, faculty, and staff may compete free of charge, and spectators are also welcome for free. Please note that there is limit of 125 competitors. Be sure to pay the registration fee. Your registration is not complete until you have paid.
